text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- National commission to monitor Moroccan elections set up.
- Budget policy shows lack of social strategy.
- Jobless graduates stage indefinite hunger strike to press for jobs.
- President of supreme court to preside over national commission in charge of following up elections.
- U.N. mission for Referendum in Western Sahara (MINURSO) might have its mandate extended.
- French newspaper Les Echos says France might convert part of Morocco's debt.
- Staff at Moroccan bank Banque du Commerce et de l'Industrie call one-day strike to protest against layoffs.
- Moroccan businessmen object to high taxation inflicted on energy sector saying it hampers competitivity.
